summary: E-Home Household Service Holdings filed a Form 6-K providing notice and proxy statement for an extraordinary general meeting on July 15, 2026. The meeting will consider a special resolution for a capital reorganization, comprising a reduction of issued share capital by canceling $1.24999 per $1.25 par ordinary share, reducing par value to $0.00001, followed by subdividing each authorized but unissued $1.25 par share into 125,000 new shares of $0.00001 par. The credit from the reduction will offset accumulated losses. This is a routine capital restructuring, not a special situation.
